entry.intro: One of you is in the dark. Can the rest of you work out who? You will play as {name}.
entry.gameGone: That game does not exist any more. Ask your friend for a fresh link.

leave.takenOver: A computer player will take over your seat and your score.

lobby.share: Friends can join with the game code on the start screen, or with your invite link. You need at least {min} players.
lobby.pickCategories: Pick which kinds of cards go into the deck.
lobby.deckSize: {count} card in the deck. | {count} cards in the deck.
lobby.notEnoughCards: That isn't enough for {players} players with {handSize} cards each ({needed} needed).
lobby.roundsEach: Times each player chooses the word
lobby.gameLength: The game ends once everyone has chosen {times}: that is {rounds} with {players}.
lobby.needMore: Need {count} more player | Need {count} more players
lobby.waitingToStart: Waiting for the host to start the game. Hands will be {handSize} cards, and everyone chooses the word {times}.

rule.word: Each round one player thinks of a word or phrase and types it in.
rule.everyoneSees: Everyone else sees it and plays the card from their hand that best fits the word.
rule.oneInTheDark: Everyone else sees it, except one random player who just sees {hidden}.
rule.bluff: They all play the card from their hand that best fits the word. The player in the dark has to bluff.
rule.reveal: The cards and the word are revealed. Talk it through and justify your choices.
rule.favourite: Then the chooser picks their favourite card, and that player scores {points}.
rule.chooserDecides: Then the vote: the chooser decides who they think was in the dark.
rule.everyoneVotes: Then the vote: everyone votes for who they think was in the dark.

everyone.title: Everyone votes
everyone.text: Everybody votes for who was in the dark. If the group spots them, each player who voted for them scores {perVote}. If the group is fooled, the imposter scores {perVote} for every player who missed them.

chooser.title: Only the chooser decides
chooser.text: Only the word-chooser guesses who was in the dark. Guess right and the chooser scores {correct}. Get fooled and the imposter scores {fooled}.

favourite.title: Favourite card (no imposter)
favourite.text: Everybody sees the word and nobody has to bluff. The chooser picks the card they like best, and the player who played it scores {points}.

table.lastRound: That was the last round: see the final scores
table.confirmEnd: End the game and return everyone to the lobby? Scores are reset.
table.confirmSkip: Abandon this round (no points) and move on to the next word-chooser?
table.confirmFavourite: Pick {name}’s card as your favourite? This ends the round.
table.confirmDecide: Decide that {name} was in the dark? This ends the round.
table.toPlay: A card still to be played
table.wordChosenHidden: The word has been chosen, but you cannot see it

status.chooseWord: Your turn: choose a word or phrase.
status.chooseWordFavourite: Everyone will see it. Pick something open to interpretation.
status.chooseWordImposter: Everyone else will see it, except one random player who sees {hidden} and has to bluff. Pick something open to interpretation.
status.lookAtHand: While you wait, have a look at your hand.
status.joinedMidRound: You joined mid-round, so you will be dealt in next round.
status.yourWord: This is your word. Waiting for everyone to play a card.
status.canSwap: You can swap it until everyone has played.
status.playInTheDark: Your turn: you did not see the word. Play a card that could fit, and blend in.
status.clickToPlay: Click a card in your hand to look closer and play it.
status.playCard: Your turn: play the card that fits the word best.
status.chooserPicks: The chooser will pick their favourite.
status.oneInTheDark: One player cannot see this word.
status.pickFavourite: Your turn: pick the card you like best.
status.decide: Your turn: who was in the dark?
status.listenFavourite: Listen to everyone explain why their card fits the word. That player scores {points}.
status.guessRight: Guess right and you score {correct}. If you are fooled, the imposter scores {fooled}.
status.willDecide: {name} will decide who was in the dark.
status.explainFavourite: Explain why your card fits the word. If {name} picks yours you score {points}.
status.explainDecide: Explain why your card fits the word. If {name} is fooled, the imposter scores {points}.
status.joinNextRound: You will join in next round.
status.vote: Your turn: vote for the player who did not see the word.
status.voteIn: Your vote is in. You can still change it.
status.explainVote: Explain why you chose your card and listen to the others. The round ends when the last vote is in.
status.discardAndDraw: Played cards are discarded and everyone draws back up to {handSize} cards.
status.groupFound: The group found them. Everyone who voted for them scores {points}.
status.groupFooled: The group was fooled! {name} scores {points} ({each} for each player who missed them).
status.gameOverAfter: Game over after {count} round. | Game over after {count} rounds.
status.hostAgain: Press "Back to the lobby" to play again, or leave (top right).
status.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to take everyone back to the lobby, or leave (top right).

log.allOnTable: All the cards are on the table.
log.imposterCaught: {name} was the imposter. They were found out.
log.imposterFooled: {name} was the imposter. They fooled the table.

errors.nameTooLong: Names can be at most {max} characters.
errors.nameTaken: Someone is already using that name.
errors.handSizeRange: Hand size must be between {min} and {max}.
errors.notEnoughCards: There are not enough cards in the chosen categories for that many players. Choose more categories.
errors.hostOnlyEnd: Only the host can end the game.
errors.hostOnlySkip: Only the host can skip a round.
errors.noRoundToSkip: There is no round to skip.
errors.notTimeToChooseWord: It is not time to choose a word.
errors.chooserOnlyWord: Only the chooser can pick the word.
errors.typeWord: Type a word or phrase first.
errors.wordTooLong: Keep it to {max} characters or fewer.
errors.nobodyToPlay: Nobody else is in this round to play a card.
errors.notPlayingThisRound: You do not play a card this round.
errors.notTimeToVote: It is not time to vote.
errors.waitingNextRound: You are waiting for the next round.
errors.chooserOnlyVotes: In this game only the word-chooser votes.
errors.voteCardPlayer: You can only vote for someone who played a card.
errors.tooManyGames: There are too many games running. Please try again later.
